evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Universal operational rule stated as settled fact — 'every' and 'completes' perform ratification without hedging or argument, the posture of a load-bearing procedure the speaker expects others to follow.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Flat unhedged factual assertion about a past event — asserted as true but not load-bearing or identity-level; a plain claim with no performed ratification or permanence language to lift it higher.
